title: Retire the Default theme conversion now that New World is the default
detail:
Plan step 9 for Default: (1) manifest to schema 2 declaring today's four dials supported with THEME_LOOK defaults (owners see no change); (2) register, accent swatches, type voice, motion, hero/header/footer variants, image treatment, Looks, theme dials as the style system allows; (3) functions table mapping existing blocks to the twelve functions; conformance suite green before any dial flips to supported. NEEDS FROM DANIEL: Updated Default style system, or confirmation it is the fallback and stays fixed.

RETIRED 2026-11-09 by Daniel. LIVE-2058 sets New World when a new Space has no explicit choice, and LIVE-2059 removes Default from the picker. The legacy theme remains available to existing sites that saved it. No style-picker conversion is needed for Default.

verify.cmd: node scripts/probes/new-world-theme.mjs default && node scripts/probes/new-world-theme.mjs picker
